Edit SOE

Edit the offset field directly (HH+MM, e.g. 3+35). Changes remain staged until Save is pressed. Choose any event as the anchor, then calculate before or after it.

Automatic correction uses the device's configured time zone and the selected event date, including daylight-saving changes. Manual correction is a global local-time offset from Zulu. Verify operational schedules and applicable limits against current authoritative guidance; this tool is not an operational approval or fitness determination.

Assumptions & Limitations

    Cold Wx

    TEMPERATURE (°C)

    Corrections are calculated from the supplied FIH Temperature Correction Chart. In TDZE mode, HAA is altitude to correct minus TDZE; in HAA mode, the entered HAA is used directly. Values between chart entries are interpolated and rounded to the nearest 10 feet.

    FIH Temperature Correction Chart

    Reference: FIH · Interpolated corrections rounded to nearest 10 FT

    Correction Table Reference: FIH Section D, 4. Temperature Errors, Temperature Correction Chart.

    IAP Applicability Reference

    IAP Applicability Reference: AFMAN 11-202V3, AFMC Supplement (AFMCSUP)

    The correction is added to the entered altitude. Verify table applicability and all results against current approved publications and procedures. This calculator is an aid only.
